channelTitle: The golden drink Grandma June makes when her joints act up
hook: It's just warm milk with one bright yellow spice stirred in, but this one has been around for generations.
remedy: Warm milk with a pinch of turmeric stirred in, sometimes called golden milk, is an old-fashioned evening drink some grandmothers made when their joints felt stiff or they just wanted something soothing before bed.
steps: Warm a cup of milk on the stove until hot but not boiling
Stir in a quarter teaspoon of turmeric and a pinch of black pepper
Sweeten with a little honey if you like, and sip while warm
caution: Honey isn't safe for babies under 1. Turmeric can interact with blood thinners, so check with your doctor if you're on medication.
cta: Have you tried golden milk before, or is this your first time hearing about it? Let Grandma June know.
